idea-plugin.name: ModuleLoom
idea-plugin.description:
ModuleLoom - Python Architecture & Automated Documentation Engine

ModuleLoom brings real-time Python module dependency graph visualization, architectural diagnostics, and an automated manual documentation engine with local AI integration directly into your PyCharm environment.

🌟 Key Features

  • 🔍 Real-time Dependency & Cycle Detection: Visualize complex package structures, trace circular import paths, and navigate directly to source files with one click.
  • 📖 Documentation Engine: Manage screenshot instructions and register PNG images of the target application, generate Mermaid architecture diagrams from AST, and publish Markdown and API references as MkDocs sites.
  • 🚨 Code Quality & Architecture Diagnostics: Multi-angle inspection of bloat, duplicate code (bundled jscpd v5), cyclomatic complexity (Lizard/AST), and missing type annotations. Automatically installs diagnostics skills to detected coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor).
  • 🤖 Local AI Integration: Connects to Codex, Claude Code, Grok, or Agy CLI using your local authentication without requiring extra API keys.
  • ⚙️ Centralized Settings: Easy configuration popup for HTML output destination, Markdown source directory, and AI CLI/model selection.
  • 🌐 Dual Language: Full support for English and Japanese (switchable in View → Language).

🇯🇵 日本語での特徴

  • 🔍 依存関係 & 循環インポートのリアルタイム可視化: 複雑なモジュール関係や循環インポート経路を可視化し、エディタと連携して即座に修正可能。
  • 📖 ドキュメント生成エンジン: 対象アプリの撮影指示とPNGの登録、Mermaid依存図、DocstringからのAPIリファレンスを原稿で管理し、MkDocsサイトをビルド。
  • 🚨 コード品質 & アーキテクチャ診断: 肥大化、重複コード（jscpd同梱）、循環、型チェックを多角的に診断し、コーディングエージェントへ診断スキルを自動導入。
  • 🤖 ローカル認証済み AI CLI 連携: Codex、Claude Code、Grok、Agy とAPIキー不要で連携。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.4.0

  • Persistent AI Update Instructions: Keep each ai:task beside its generated result so screenshots and other assets remain refreshable.
  • Reliable Screenshot Capture: Capture the documentation settings dialog directly and reject empty or invalid PNG data.
  • Manual Asset Registration: Register existing manual screenshots as updateable assets and keep the Markdown source and built site synchronized.

v1.3.0

  • AI Draft Templates: Create user manuals and API documentation drafts from project context with configurable AI agents, models, and directories.
  • Safer Regeneration: Validate drafts before replacing source pages, back up existing Markdown, and preserve manual source data during site builds.
  • Recoverable Site Publishing: Keep user files in the output directory and restore the prior site if publishing fails.

v1.2.0

  • MarkIts Vector Annotation Engine: Integrated MarkIts (v0.2.0) for professional vector SVG annotations (callouts, pins, badges, spotlights, step/bezier arrows).
  • Full AI Text Updates: One-click batch updates for all AI text tasks ("✍️ 全AIテキスト更新") and granular card-level generation controls.
  • Asset Jump & Highlight: Clicking an asset card automatically scrolls to its exact location in the preview with pulse animation in both HTML and Markdown modes.
  • Streamlined Documentation Flow: Removed legacy API catalog to focus on seamless synchronization of Screenshots, Diagrams, and Explanations.

v1.1.0

  • Automated Documentation Engine: Automatic batch screenshot capture with smart annotations, Mermaid dependency diagram extraction.
  • Centralized Settings Popup: Easy configuration for HTML export target, Markdown source directory, and AI CLI/model settings.
  • Unified Feature Parity: 100% feature parity across Desktop app, PyCharm plugin, and VS Code extension.
